description: An initializer inside `if=` content calls a function whose local part write (`r.lo = k`, `Range` has an invariant) is checked when it runs: it can trap, so E-FILE-SCOPE-INIT-IN-CONSTRUCT.
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S482-trapping-construct-init ("yes, interim refusal now and the feature later")
rationale: Ruling S482-trapping-construct-init: "extend E-FILE-SCOPE-INIT-IN-CONSTRUCT to an initializer inside a construct that can fail at run time" — an invariant check is a §19.17 trap site.
